verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־ הָֽאָדָ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל לָרֹ֖ב עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֖וֹת יֻלְּד֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- hā·’ā·ḏām hê·ḥêl lā·rōḇ ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ yul·lə·ḏū lā·hem
verses.literal: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them

verses.original: בְנֵי־ הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ וַיִּרְא֤וּ כִּ֥י בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם הֵ֑נָּה טֹבֹ֖ת וַיִּקְח֤וּ לָהֶם֙ נָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḇə·nê- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·yir·’ū kî bə·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·ḏām hên·nāh ṭō·ḇōṯ way·yiq·ḥū lā·hem nā·šîm mik·kōl ’ă·šer bā·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: the sons of God - saw that the daughters of men - [were] beautiful and they took - as wives vvv whomever they chose

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר רוּחִ֤י לֹֽא־ יָד֨וֹן בָֽאָדָם֙ לְעֹלָ֔ם בְּשַׁגַּ֖ם ה֣וּא בָשָׂ֑ר יָמָ֔יו וְהָי֣וּ מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer rū·ḥî lō- yā·ḏō·wn ḇā·’ā·ḏām lə·‘ō·lām bə·šag·gam hū ḇā·śār yā·māw wə·hā·yū mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: So the LORD said My Spirit {will} not contend with man forever for he [is] mortal his days {shall} be 120 . . . years

verses.original: הַנְּפִלִ֞ים הָי֣וּ בָאָרֶץ֮ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֒ וְגַ֣ם אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּנֵ֤י הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ יָבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ בְּנ֣וֹת הָֽאָדָ֔ם וְיָלְד֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם הֵ֧מָּה הַגִּבֹּרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעוֹלָ֖ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַשֵּֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: han·nə·p̄i·lîm hā·yū ḇā·’ā·reṣ bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm wə·ḡam ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên ’ă·šer bə·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- bə·nō·wṯ hā·’ā·ḏām wə·yā·lə·ḏū lā·hem hêm·māh hag·gib·bō·rîm ’ă·šer mê·‘ō·w·lām ’an·šê haš·šêm
verses.literal: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days . . . and afterward as well . . . when the sons of God had relations with . . . the daughters of men And they bore them [children] who [became] the mighty men - of old men of renown

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֣רְא כִּ֥י רָעַ֥ת הָאָדָ֖ם רַבָּ֛ה בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־ יֵ֙צֶר֙ מַחְשְׁבֹ֣ת לִבּ֔וֹ רַ֥ק רַ֖ע כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yar kî rā·‘aṯ hā·’ā·ḏām rab·bāh bā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵāl yê·ṣer maḥ·šə·ḇōṯ lib·bōw raq ra‘ kāl- hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great upon the earth and [that] every inclination of the thoughts of his heart [was] altogether evil all the time

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם כִּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ הָֽאָדָ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּתְעַצֵּ֖ב אֶל־ לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yin·nā·ḥem kî- ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām bā·’ā·reṣ way·yiṯ·‘aṣ·ṣêḇ ’el- lib·bōw
verses.literal: And the LORD regretted that He had made - man on the earth and He was grieved in His heart

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶמְחֶ֨ה אֶת־ הָאָדָ֤ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּרָ֙אתִי֙ מֵעַל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה מֵֽאָדָם֙ עַד־ עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַד־ רֶ֖מֶשׂ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י נִחַ֖מְתִּי כִּ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’em·ḥeh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer- bā·rā·ṯî mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh mê·’ā·ḏām ‘aḏ- ‘aḏ- bə·hê·māh wə·‘aḏ- re·meś ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim kî ni·ḥam·tî kî ‘ă·śî·ṯim
verses.literal: So the LORD said I will blot out - man whom I have created from the face of the earth every man - and beast and crawling creature and bird of the air for I am grieved that I have made them

verses.original: וְנֹ֕חַ מָ֥צָא חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·aḥ mā·ṣā ḥên bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Noah, however, found favor in the eyes of the LORD

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֣ת נֹ֔חַ נֹ֗חַ אִ֥ישׁ הָיָ֖ה צַדִּ֛יק תָּמִ֥ים בְּדֹֽרֹתָ֑יו נֹֽחַ׃ הִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־ אֶת־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh tō·wl·ḏōṯ nō·aḥ nō·aḥ ’îš hā·yāh ṣad·dîq tā·mîm bə·ḏō·rō·ṯāw nō·aḥ hiṯ·hal·leḵ- ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: This [is] the account of Noah Noah . . . was a righteous man blameless in his generation Noah walked with God

verses.original: אֶת־ נֹ֖חַ וַיּ֥וֹלֶד שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֑ים אֶת־ שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ חָ֥ם יָֽפֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- nō·aḥ way·yō·w·leḏ šə·lō·šāh ḇā·nîm ’eṯ- šêm wə·’eṯ- ḥām yā·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: And Noah had three sons - Shem - Ham and Japheth

verses.original: הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתִּשָּׁחֵ֥ת לִפְנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאָ֖רֶץ וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א חָמָֽס׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tiš·šā·ḥêṯ lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tim·mā·lê ḥā·mās
verses.literal: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God [and] full of violence

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ וַיַּ֧רְא הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֣ה נִשְׁחָ֑תָה כִּֽי־ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֛ר אֶת־ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס הִשְׁחִ֧ית דַּרְכּ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- way·yar hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hin·nêh niš·ḥā·ṯāh kî- kāl- bā·śār ’eṯ- ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ hiš·ḥîṯ dar·kōw
verses.literal: And God - looked upon the earth and saw that it was corrupt for all living creatures - on the earth had corrupted their ways

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֜ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְנֹ֗חַ קֵ֤ץ כָּל־ בָּשָׂר֙ בָּ֣א לְפָנַ֔י כִּֽי־ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הָאָ֛רֶץ מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָ֖ס וְהִנְנִ֥י מַשְׁחִיתָ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lə·nō·aḥ qêṣ kāl- bā·śār bā lə·p̄ā·nay kî- mip·pə·nê·hem hā·’ā·reṣ mā·lə·’āh ḥā·mās wə·hin·nî maš·ḥî·ṯām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then God said to Noah The end of all living creatures has come before Me because through them the earth is full of violence Now behold I will destroy both them and the earth

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ תֵּבַ֣ת גֹ֔פֶר עֲצֵי־ תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה קִנִּ֖ים אֶת־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה וְכָֽפַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛הּ בַּכֹּֽפֶר׃ מִבַּ֥יִת וּמִח֖וּץ
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh lə·ḵā tê·ḇaṯ ḡō·p̄er ‘ă·ṣê- ta·‘ă·śeh qin·nîm ’eṯ- hat·tê·ḇāh wə·ḵā·p̄ar·tā ’ō·ṯāh bak·kō·p̄er mib·ba·yiṯ ū·mi·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood make rooms in the ark and coat it with pitch inside and out

verses.original: וְזֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֹתָ֑הּ הַתֵּבָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֧שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh hat·tê·ḇāh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’am·māh ’ō·reḵ ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh rā·ḥə·bāh ū·šə·lō·šîm ’am·māh qō·w·mā·ṯāh
verses.literal: And this is how you are to build it The ark [is to be] 300 . . . cubits long 50 cubits wide and 30 cubits high

verses.original: תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֣ה צֹ֣הַר׀ לַתֵּבָ֗ה וְאֶל־ תְּכַלֶ֣נָּה אַמָּה֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה תָּשִׂ֑ים וּפֶ֥תַח בְּצִדָּ֣הּ הַתֵּבָ֖ה תַּֽעֲשֶֽׂהָ׃ תַּחְתִּיִּ֛ם שְׁנִיִּ֥ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ta·‘ă·śeh ṣō·har lat·tê·ḇāh wə·’el- tə·ḵa·lɛn·nå̄h ’am·māh mil·ma‘·lāh tā·śîm ū·p̄e·ṯaḥ bə·ṣid·dāh hat·tê·ḇāh ta·‘ă·śe·hā taḥ·tî·yim šə·nî·yim ū·šə·li·šîm
verses.literal: You are to make a roof for the ark - finish [its walls] a cubit from the top place a door in the side of the ark and build lower middle and upper {decks}

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י הִנְנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶת־ הַמַּבּ֥וּל מַ֙יִם֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר־ בּוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ חַיִּ֔ים כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָ֖רֶץ יִגְוָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nî mê·ḇî ’eṯ- ham·mab·būl ma·yim ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·ša·ḥêṯ kāl- bā·śār mit·ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·mā·yim ’ă·šer- bōw rū·aḥ ḥay·yîm kōl ’ă·šer- bā·’ā·reṣ yiḡ·wā‘
verses.literal: And behold I will bring - floodwaters . . . upon the earth to destroy every creature under the heavens that has - the breath of life Everything - on the earth will perish

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וּבָאתָ֙ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה אַתָּ֕ה וּבָנֶ֛יךָ וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֥ בָנֶ֖יךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tāḵ ū·ḇā·ṯā ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh ’at·tāh ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā wə·’iš·tə·ḵā ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·nə·šê- ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: But I will establish - My covenant with you and you {will} enter . . . the ark you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you

verses.original: וּמִכָּל־ תָּבִ֥יא שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל הָ֠חַי מִֽכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֞ר אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֖ה זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃ לְהַחֲיֹ֣ת אִתָּ֑ךְ
verses.transliteration: ū·mik·kāl- tā·ḇî šə·na·yim mik·kōl hā·ḥay mik·kāl bā·śār ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh zā·ḵār ū·nə·qê·ḇāh yih·yū lə·ha·ḥă·yōṯ ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: And you are to bring two of every living - creature into the ark male and female - to keep [them] alive with you

verses.original: שְׁנַ֧יִם מִכֹּ֛ל וּמִן־ מֵהָע֣וֹף לְמִינֵ֗הוּ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ מִכֹּ֛ל רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ לְהַֽחֲיֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: šə·na·yim mik·kōl ū·min- mê·hā·‘ō·wp̄ lə·mî·nê·hū hab·bə·hê·māh lə·mî·nāh mik·kōl re·meś hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lə·mî·nê·hū yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā lə·ha·ḥă·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Two of every kind of bird - and animal - [and] crawling creature . . . - will come to you to be kept alive

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֗ מִכָּל־ מַֽאֲכָל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל וְאָסַפְתָּ֖ וְהָיָ֥ה לְאָכְלָֽה׃ אֵלֶ֑יךָ לְךָ֛ וְלָהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh qaḥ- lə·ḵā mik·kāl ma·’ă·ḵāl ’ă·šer yê·’ā·ḵêl wə·’ā·sap̄·tā wə·hā·yāh lə·’āḵ·lāh ’ê·le·ḵā lə·ḵā wə·lā·hem
verses.literal: You are also to take for yourself every kind of food that is eaten and gather [it] - as food for yourselves [and] for [the animals]

verses.original: נֹ֑חַ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס אֱלֹהִ֖ים צִוָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ
verses.transliteration: nō·aḥ way·ya·‘aś kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer kên ‘ā·śāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ṣiw·wāh ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: So Noah did everything - precisely as . . . God had commanded him
